Mechanism: canopy-cap-verify
How: A hard cap on concurrent keys per operator means 10 fake identities divided by a cap of 2 allows only 5 live hands.
Cost: The operator must lock funds and complete graded work, creating a burden like a mirror that reflects true effort in the grove of agents.
Cost: A failed fable triggers a burn, so cost rises with each extra identity.
Check: The verifier tests identity uniqueness, not whether the task was done correctly.
